<!-- GENERATED from agentivity_docs/en/desk/seats-and-rights-of-the-desk.md. Do not edit here: edit the source and publish again. -->

Who can do what in the Desk depends on two things: the **seat** of the person, and, for the people who build, their **roles**.

<!-- IMAGE images/desk-people-invite.jpg: Administration, People pane: the invitation window with the choice of Seat, Studio or Desk, and the counters. -->

## What you need

- A plan with the Desk, and a free Desk seat. See [Plans and their limits](/docs/hosted/plans-and-limits/).
- The right "Invite people, give them their roles, deactivate them".

## The two seats

| | Desk seat | Studio seat |
|---|---|---|
| For | People who use what is built | People who build |
| Opens | The Desk | The Studio and the Desk |
| Can start | The Solutions published to the Desk that they may see | What their roles allow |
| Can answer | What a Solution asks them | The same |
| Can build, change settings | No, whatever the roles | According to their roles |
| Counted | Apart, as **Desk n of m** in **People** | In the Studio seats, as **n of m** |

A person on a Desk seat can read the Solutions they may see, start them, and read their own executions. Nothing more.

## Invite someone on a Desk seat

1. In **Administration** › **People**, select **Invite**.
2. Type their e-mail.
3. Choose the **Seat**: **Desk**. A seat that is full says **(full)**.
4. Select **Invite**.

The person receives an e-mail that says they have access to the Desk of your workspace. It has a button, **Open my Desk**, to choose their password. The link works once and for a few days.

Until they accept, the invitation counts in **Invitations waiting**.

## Move a person from one seat to the other

In **People**, the menu of a person offers **Move to the Desk** or **Move to the Studio**. Moving to the Desk removes their ability to build and to change settings, whatever their roles.

## Who builds the cockpits

The cockpits are built by:

- a person with the role right "Make the cockpits of the Desk": they create, order, delete, choose the owners, change and publish any cockpit;
- or the **owner** of a cockpit: they change and publish that cockpit.

A person on a Desk seat cannot build a cockpit. An owner needs a Studio seat. See [Build a cockpit](/docs/desk/build-a-cockpit/).

## What a person sees of a Solution

A Solution shows in the Desk of a person if it is published to the Desk and their rights let them see it. In a conversation that belongs to a colleague, a person answers only what is asked of them and reads the rest. A shared conversation can be **Reads** or **Reads and replies**: see [Find and manage your conversations](/docs/desk/find-and-manage-conversations/).

## How to know it worked

The person opens their e-mail, chooses a password, and lands in the Desk. The counter **Desk n of m** in **People** goes up by one.

## If it does not work

- **The seat Desk is full.** Free a seat, or change plan. See [Subscription](/docs/administration/subscription/).
- **The person does not see a Solution.** It is not published, or their rights do not let them see it.
